info.title: Critical Path realtime and webhook events
info.description: Generated from src/services/realtime/payloads.ts by `npm run realtime:dump`. RealtimeEvent is the envelope a /ws socket receives; WebhookEvent is the body POSTed to a project webhook registration. Not an HTTP API: it declares no paths.
